verdict.rationale: LiteLLM's proxy and Router document gateway-level rules that switch models when availability fails: fallbacks across model groups after retries, automatic failover to healthy backups, cooldowns and timeouts, and load-balancing across deployments. Content-policy fallbacks also reroute based on error type, and the Show HN launch corroborates reliable model switching as the core purpose. Missing for 10: explicit cost-based routing rules (budgets and spend tracking exist, but nothing shown that routes by cost), capability-based routing beyond the marketing line about sending each request to the right model, and independent hands-on corroboration of mid-task switching.
